characters.name: Elf
characters.clothing: The elf wears a forest‑green linen tunic with delicate silver trim along the neckline and cuffs. The tunic is layered over a white linen shirt that shows at the collar. Beneath the tunic she has brown leather breeches tucked into soft, knee‑high leather boots of dark tan. Around her shoulders drapes an elven hooded cape in matching forest green made from fine wool. She accessorises with a silver chain necklace and small silver earrings
characters.appearance: beautiful female elf with silver hair streaming down her shoulders
characters.position: steps in, takes a seat at the back table and accepts a crystal chalice from Amy

characters.name: Dragon‑shaped creature
characters.appearance: scales glittering like polished obsidian, wings unfurl revealing a pair of amber eyes that scan the room
characters.position: slides onto a high bar stool and licks its lips before taking a slow sip of a special brew from Amy
